kxsge01.title: The Aries Guide: Love at Full Speed
kxsge01.caption:
Texted back in 0.4 seconds and called it romance? Your whole guide, Aries.
Fast is your love language. This week, ask one big question and listen all the way to the end.

kxsge02.title: The Taurus Guide: Slow, Sure, Stubborn
kxsge02.caption:
Three days of waiting for them to text first, Taurus. They might be waiting too.
Your steady love is the gift. This week, send the first "thinking of you." It costs nothing.

kxsge03.title: The Gemini Guide: Twelve Tabs Open
kxsge03.caption:
It's 2 a.m., twelve chats are open, and none of them are real yet.
Gemini, your words are a gift. This week, trade the typing for one call and let them hear you laugh.

kxsge04.title: The Cancer Guide: Everyone's Soup
kxsge04.caption:
You fed everyone, gave everyone advice, and never sat down once.
Cancer, your care is beautiful. This week, let someone bring the bowl to you, and say yes.

kxsge05.title: The Leo Guide: Who Clapped?
kxsge05.caption:
Leo, one clap is not a verdict on how loved you are. Sometimes they're just tired.
This week, ask about their day, then ask again, and watch them light up.

kxsge06.title: The Virgo Guide: Draft Fourteen
kxsge06.caption:
Fourteen takes of one voice note. We've all been there, Virgo.
The people who love you want you, not polish. Send the first draft this week.
